_about: Fantasy adventure: places of wonder and danger, and a reason to go. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

hook: a map in a dead man's boot
a village that pays in gold it should not have
a road nobody has walked for a hundred years
a heir who must be found
a temple that sank and rose again
threat: a warlord gathering the hill clans
a plague that turns people to stone
giants coming down from the mountains
a curse on the royal line
place: a city built on a giant's bones
a forest that moves at night
complication: a rival party wants it too
the threat has a fair grievance

cliches: a dark lord in black armour
